### E&F + Tech & Res ComPatch Fix (Vic3 1.13) -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
###
### Source: the compatch's own common/script_values/zef_00_economic_scripted_value.txt
### (Morgenroete goods NOT merged -- rerun with --morg for a build with it).
### Regenerate with tools/regen_ef_tr_copies.py after any update of either.
###
### Each basket is a weighted average: sum(price deviation * buy orders) over
### the goods, divided by 0.1 + sum(buy orders) over the same goods. A good in
### the numerator but not the divisor pushes the reading up; a good in the
### divisor but not the numerator dilutes it towards zero. Both halves must
### list the same goods, and in the compatch they do not.
###
### E&F's own hardwood-in-the-divisor-only quirk is left alone here -- it is
### in E&F itself, in three baskets, and belongs in the E&F hotfix.
###
### Fixes applied this run:
###   inflation_on_manufactured_goods: added market.mg:alloys to the divisor
###   inflation_on_raw_material: added market.mg:bauxite to the divisor
###   inflation_on_raw_material: de-duplicated market.mg:hardwood in the divisor
